args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)

FIN-212 requires ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but round_money was using
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build to fail. Switch the import
and quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and the tests:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding` (run ci-0001).
